blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State-run National Transmission Corp. (TransCo) is stepping up measures to protect electricity supply in remote areas of Mindoro and Palawan amid the potential impact of the super El Niño on the power system. TransCo president and CEO Joseph Omar Castillo said the agency has been closely teaming up with other government agencies, such as the National Power Corp., and electric cooperatives to ensure an adequate power supply. READ: More brownouts possible amid El Niño threat – DOE The talks focus on assuring an adequate supply and keeping transmission facilities in good condition to lessen outages in those areas.
